instructions: Verlato helps agents inspect git ranges, generate structured draft release notes, review draft items, and apply changelog or GitHub release-note updates. Change evidence comes from the IntentumDiff semantic diff: use verlato_get_file_semantic_diff and verlato_search_semantic_diff to see meaningful changes, refactorings, moved code and ignored formatting, and never describe moved code, refactorings or formatting as new behavior. Raw patches are not exposed.
